component.name: Surface UEFI
component.summary: System firmware for the Surface Laptop 4 with AMD

description.p: Microsoft's system firmware, from its drivers and firmware package for this model.
Addresses potential security vulnerabilities that may allow escalation of privilege, denial of service, or information disclosure: CVE-2026-6727 and CVE-2026-6726 (4.501.140).
Addresses a potential security vulnerability related to advisory CVE-2025-3770 that may allow arbitrary code execution with System Management Mode privileges (4.391.140).
Addresses a potential security vulnerability related to AMD advisory CVE-2021-26383 that may allow out-of-bounds memory access (4.380.140).
Addresses potential security vulnerabilities related to AMD advisory CVE-2024-36352 that may allow denial of service or out-of-bounds read and write (4.375.140).
Enhances the stability of the device, reducing blue screens during reboot and shutdown (4.360.140).
